As a Customs Brokerage Agent you play an important part in the  coördination of of logistics flows.

• Do you already have a similar experience?

If yes, continue reading!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented with a strong understanding of international trade and customs regulations? As a Customs Brokerage Agent, you are someone who can provide superior global logistics and trade compliance services to our clients.

Your expertise will help clients navigate complex regulations, ensuring timely and efficient delivery of shipments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as a Customs Brokerage Agent:

• Ensure smooth and timely customs process flow
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operational system
• Track and Trace Custom files and reporting
• Key all air, ocean and truck files according to KPI and customer requirements in
compliance with all rules and regulations.
• Ensure accurate and timely client billing
• Understand all the elements of the import and export customs Desk Level Operating Procedure and correctly interpret this information to fulfill our customers instructions and expectations.
• Transfer customs declaration information from documents, or other sources into the customs entry system to allow for the build of a valid customs declaration
• Assist with verification of customs declaration information and the submission of such to the customs authority
• Ensure compliance at all times to regulations

As a Customs Brokerage Agent, the following characteristics are important:

• 2 years of experience Within customs
• Experience of the incoterms ,be able to calculate and apply
• Good knowledge of customs brokerage process, customs legislation - especially with regards to classification, valuation and origin
• Understanding of ocean, road and air documentation process
• Effective interpersonal skills
• Pro-active approach, strong organizational and computer skills
• Good computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word)
• Fluent in English & Dutch

I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.

jobs.occupation: Indirect Buyer & Fleet Coordinator - International company
jobs.description:
Our client, an international company located in the region of Ghent, is looking for an Indirect Buyer & Fleet Coordinator EMEA to join the team.

Jobomschrijving

In this dynamic role as Indirect Buyer and Fleet Coordinator you will have following key responsibilities:

Fleet Management (EMEA)

• Act as the primary point of contact for fleet-related matters across EMEA
• Coordinate with leasing partners and support employees on all fleet topics
• Manage the full vehicle lifecycle: ordering, registration, insurance, maintenance, and returns
• Maintain accurate fleet data (vehicles, drivers, contracts, mileage, renewals)
• Handle damage cases, fines, insurance claims, and country-specific exceptions
• Support employee onboarding with vehicle allocation, documentation, and policy guidance
• Ensure compliance with local regulations, company car policies, and duty-of-care standards
Indirect Procurement

• Manage end-to-end purchasing for indirect categories (services, MRO, facilities, packaging, tooling, professional services)
• Create and maintain purchase orders in line with pricing agreements, lead times, and approval policies
• Source, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to optimise cost efficiency and total cost of ownership (TCO)
• Resolve operational issues such as order confirmations, invoice discrepancies, and delivery delays
• Collaborate closely with Finance, Logistics, Quality, Legal, and Operations to ensure seamless execution
In this position you will report to the SC Manager.

• You obtained a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent
• You have a first relevant experience in fleet management or indirect procurement 
• You have a strong understanding of procurement policies, approval workflows, and supplier management
• You work in a structured way and you 'get things done'
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French is strongly preferred
• You thrive in an international context
